beats.narration_says: Every cargo that came off a Carthaginian ship was counted twice. Once by the captain who brought it, and once by a clerk who had never been to sea.
beats.viewer_sees: A clerk on the quay marking a wax tablet, then holding it out to a captain who checks the count with his thumb.
